# VIAS Valve Rattle Fix

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Drill a hole through the movable VIAS valve fin and thread in a coarse threaded screw to press upward on the rigid plenum fin. [t30]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Locate the plastic fin on the outside of the VIAS valve that is restricted by two other rigid fins attached to the intake plenum.
2. Drill a hole through the movable valve fin, taking care not to drill completely through the opposing rigid plenum fin resting against it.
3. Select one coarse threaded screw from your mud-flaps set.
4. Thread the selected screw into the drilled hole just enough so that its point touches and presses upward on the rigid plenum fin below.
5. Verify that this pressure raises the valve fin slightly off of the plenum to stop the rattle while still allowing it to function.

_Procedure reported by [t30]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.thenewx.org/threads/how-to-vias-rattle-fix.181130/>_

## Parts

- Coarse threaded screw from mud-flaps [t30]
